description: This file contains the definition of the VoucherTheme class within the Opencart\\Catalog\\Model\\Checkout namespace. The class interacts with the database to retrieve voucher theme information, including individual voucher themes and lists of voucher themes, with support for caching and query filtering.

classes.name: VoucherTheme
classes.description: A model class responsible for retrieving voucher theme data from the database, including individual themes and lists of themes with filtering and ordering options.

methods.name: getVoucherTheme
methods.description: Retrieves a specific voucher theme by its ID, joining its description for the current language.

methods.name: getVoucherThemes
methods.description: Fetches a list of voucher themes, possibly filtered by order, start index, and limit, with caching support.
